mine.title: How your own voice sounds in a conversation
mine.said: Your takes now play at 1.2 times speed, levelled, with long pauses trimmed to about a quarter second, and the record button's click removed by its shape. An agent chose the thresholds alone; you'd said 1.2 for all your voices. A slightly long pause is kept over a clipped breath.
options: A fixed trim of each take's edges
Cut at the transcript's word edges
mine.why: The speed came from you, but how tight the pauses are and what counts as a click no check could settle.
mine.undo: Change the take policy's numbers; a single turn can override speed, loudness and gaps.

mine.title: How alive the cast looks
mine.said: Mochi and Tin Bird sway, bob and react with numbers tuned on the runners essay, lowered after you said shake a little, not too much. Emotion notes are spaced out so nothing pulses on every word. An agent chose them alone, under your rule that natural motion wins.
mine.why: No check can say what reads as alive and calm at once; you judge it on the preview.
mine.undo: Move the numbers in the living layer, and record the move.

mine.title: Longer notes, and how long a conversation runs
mine.said: Your spoken notes may now run to four thousand characters, up from six hundred, which refused your real ones. A conversation may run twenty minutes, measured from its audio rather than guessed from words. An agent moved these alone, as policy that follows the story.
options: Four thousand characters and twenty measured minutes
Reuse the cards essays' twelve minutes
mine.why: How long a note or conversation may run is a preference about content, and no limit had been set.
mine.undo: Edit the two limits in the conversation policy.

mine.title: A spoken cards essay may run twelve minutes
mine.said: A spoken cards essay may now run twelve minutes, up from ten, so the diagnosis essay you bounded at twelve could be published whole. The routine still aims for about eight. An agent chose to apply it to every essay, not just that one.
options: Keep ten and cut the essay
No cap beyond home's render policy
mine.why: You bounded one essay at twelve without saying whether every essay may.
mine.undo: Set the cap back to ten minutes.

mine.title: A cheat sheet holds six rows, in two columns
mine.said: A cheat sheet now holds at most six rows, down from eight, laid in two columns in the wide frame instead of being refused. Every sheet so far has three to six. An agent chose this alone.
options: Keep eight and refuse what doesn't fit
mine.why: How a sheet is drawn and how many rows it holds is a look you see on screen.
mine.undo: Set the row limit back and drop the two-column layout.

mine.title: Asks left the phone
mine.said: At your word, asks left the phone for the desktop Asks page. An agent chose to keep the routine filing any spoken answer already on home, so nothing you recorded goes unfiled.
options: Remove asks from the phone, keep filing answers already on home
Remove the filing too, at once
Keep a read-only list on the phone
mine.why: You asked to prune asks from the phone, but not whether answers already on home should still be filed.
mine.undo: Restore the phone's ask screens from history.

mine.title: What you paste on Asks stays in that tab
mine.said: What you tick and paste on the Asks page is kept only in that browser tab, with anything that looks like a secret blanked first. Closing the tab lets it go; nothing is sent anywhere until you copy the receipt. An agent chose this alone.
options: The tab only, with secrets blanked
mine.why: A pasted log can carry a secret, and keeping it longer trades against losing a half-done checklist.
mine.undo: Keep receipts in the browser's lasting storage instead.

mine.title: The Cooking page holds twelve trains
mine.said: The Cooking page shows at most twelve of your goals as trains, five to a page, and says when a thirteenth isn't drawn. You'd said ten or twelve; an agent picked twelve.
mine.why: You gave ten or twelve without a number.

mine.title: A late essay stays on the board
mine.said: When an owed essay's Monday passes, it now stays under Coming, marked late, with what it waits on, for three weeks. Before, it simply vanished and the board read as a quiet week. An agent chose the reasons and the words.
options: Keep a passed day, said late, with its reason
Drop a passed day, as before
mine.why: Which reasons to name, and in what words, no check settles.
mine.undo: Drop the late rows and read two weeks again.

mine.title: A note is heard within twenty-five minutes
mine.said: Home promises a voice note is heard within twenty-five minutes, which covers the turn it gives to renders. An agent chose twenty-five over fifteen, which would page on every such turn.
options: Exempt the renders' turn from the alert
mine.why: Whether twenty-five suits your notes only real use shows.
mine.undo: Lower the bound; its compile-time check says what it no longer covers.

mine.title: How closely a hunch must match a phrase
mine.said: The shop shows a phrase only when your hunch is close to it, set from the real model's scores on the fourteen seed phrases. It errs toward a miss, and a miss is kept for later, since a wrong phrase costs more. An agent chose the line alone.
options: A high bar, erring toward a miss
A lower bar, with more false hits
mine.why: The model is coarse: honest paraphrases miss, and unrelated sentences can come close.
mine.undo: Change the threshold on home, with a new call.

mine.title: The game feed sleeps between games
mine.said: The scoreboard is read an hour before the next chosen kickoff, or once a day, while no chosen game is live. An agent picked the hour and the day.
options: An hour before, once a day
Every six hours on a quiet day
mine.why: How many reads a quiet day costs against how soon a change is learned is yours to notice.
mine.undo: Change the two numbers in the game feed.

mine.title: A module is silent after four weeks
mine.said: A walkthrough now calls a module silent after four whole weeks unopened. One whose opening isn't measured is never called silent. An agent picked four.
mine.why: A shorter span names more modules, and you see the list in public videos.

mine.said: The two characters' wing is called Cast, on the launcher and in the foyer. You said you didn't know what to call it, so an agent kept the working name; it's yours to rename.
mine.why: You see the name on the launcher, and left it open.

mine.title: Cleaning your takes runs on home without Python

Pure ffmpeg, which isn't what you heard
mine.why: Whether a port stands for what you heard is a judgment; it was compared on your own take once.
mine.undo: Put Python in the render image and run the original there.
